/**
 * Room Response Simulation Benchmark
 * 
 * This is a simplified, purely sequential implementation of room impulse response
 * simulation using radiosity-based wave propagation. It models how sound/light
 * waves propagate between surfaces in a room by computing:
 * 
 * 1. Form factors (Kij) between all pairs of triangles based on visibility and geometry
 * 2. Wave propagation using radiosity equations with time delays (Tau)
 * 3. Distance estimation via cross-correlation of radiosity values
 * 
 * The implementation generates a procedural icosphere mesh to simulate a room.
 */

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <random>
#include <vector>

#include "../common/results_output.hpp"

// ============================================================================
// Types and Constants
// ============================================================================

using idx_t = uint32_t;
using val_t = float;

constexpr val_t PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;
constexpr val_t ZERO = 0.0f;
constexpr val_t ONE = 1.0f;
constexpr val_t WAVE_SPEED = 0.5f;        // Wave propagation speed (units per timestep)
constexpr val_t INV_WAVE_SPEED = 1.0f / WAVE_SPEED;
constexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling
constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;

// ============================================================================
// Vector and Triangle Types
// ============================================================================

struct Vec3 {
    val_t x, y, z;

    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) {}

    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator*(val_t s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }
    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }

    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }
    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {
        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};
    }

    val_t squaredNorm() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }
    val_t norm() const { return std::sqrt(squaredNorm()); }
    Vec3 normalized() const {
        val_t n = norm();
        return n > EPSILON ? *this / n : Vec3();
    }

    bool operator==(const Vec3& o) const {
        return std::abs(x - o.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - o.y) < EPSILON && std::abs(z - o.z) < EPSILON;
    }
};

struct Triangle {
    Vec3 a, b, c;
    Vec3 _normal;

    Triangle() = default;
    Triangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c)
        : a(a), b(b), c(c), _normal((b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()) {}

    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }
    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }

    val_t area() const {
        Vec3 ab = b - a;
        Vec3 ac = c - a;
        return 0.5f * ab.cross(ac).norm();
    }

    bool operator==(const Triangle& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c; }
};

// ============================================================================
// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)
// ============================================================================

// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap
bool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {
    // Translate triangle to box center
    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;
    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;
    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;

    // Triangle edges
    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;
    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;
    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;

    // Test box normals (AABB axes)
    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {
        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));
    };

    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);
    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;

    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);
    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;

    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);
    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;

    // Test triangle normal
    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);
    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);
    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +
              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +
              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);
    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;

    // Test 9 edge cross products
    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {
        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);
        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);
        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);
        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +
                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +
                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);
        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);
        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);
    };

    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};
    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};
    for (const auto& axis : axes) {
        for (const auto& edge : edges) {
            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);
            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {
                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;
            }
        }
    }

    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Octree for Spatial Acceleration
// ============================================================================

constexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;
constexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;

class Octree {
public:
    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;
    Vec3 halfExtent, center;
    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];
    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list
    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles

    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}

    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {
        allTriangles = &triangles;
        if (triangles.empty()) return;

        // Compute bounding box
        minBound = triangles[0].a;
        maxBound = triangles[0].a;
        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {
            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {
                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);
                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);
                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);
                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);
                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);
                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);
            }
        }

        // Collect all indices
        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;

        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);
    }

private:
    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {
        minBound = nodeMin;
        maxBound = nodeMax;
        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;
        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;

        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf
        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||
            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {
            triangleIndices = indices;
            return;
        }

        // Subdivide into 8 children
        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;
        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];

        for (size_t idx : indices) {
            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];

            // Check which children this triangle overlaps
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
                Vec3 childCenter = center;
                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;
                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;
                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;

                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {
                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);
                }
            }
        }

        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)
        bool canSplit = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {
                canSplit = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!canSplit) {
            triangleIndices = indices;
            return;
        }

        // Build children
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {
                Vec3 childMin = center;
                Vec3 childMax = center;
                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;

                Vec3 childMin = center;
                Vec3 childMax = center;
                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;
                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;
                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;
                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;
                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;
                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;

                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();
                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;
                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);
            }
        }
    }

public:
    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box
    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {
        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;
        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;
        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};

        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;
        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;
        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;

        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;
        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;
        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;

        return true;
    }

    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray
    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle
    template<typename Func>
    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {
        // If leaf node, check triangles directly
        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {
            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {
                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;
            }
            return false;
        }

        // Otherwise, descend to children
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {
                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};

// ============================================================================
// Mesh Generation: Icosphere
// ============================================================================

// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron
class IcosphereMesh {
public:
    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;

    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {
        // Initial icosahedron vertices
        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;

        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {
            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,
            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius
        };

        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)
        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {
            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},
            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},
            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},
            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}
        };

        // Subdivide
        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {
            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;
            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;

            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {
                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));
                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);
                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;

                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;
                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;
                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());
                vertices.push_back(mid);
                midpointCache[key] = idx;
                return idx;
            };

            for (const auto& face : faces) {
                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);
                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);
                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);

                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});
                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});
                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});
                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});
            }
            faces = std::move(newFaces);
        }

        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a "room")
        triangles.reserve(faces.size());
        for (const auto& face : faces) {
            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward
            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);
        }
    }
};

// ============================================================================
// Random Number Generation
// ============================================================================

class RandomGenerator {
    std::mt19937 rng;
    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;
public:
    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}
    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }
};

// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates
Vec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {
    val_t u = rng.rand();
    val_t v = rng.rand();
    if (u + v > 1.0f) {
        u = 1.0f - u;
        v = 1.0f - v;
    }
    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;
    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;
    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;
}

// ============================================================================
// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)
// ============================================================================

val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,
                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {
    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;
    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;
    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);
    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);

    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();

    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;
    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;
    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;
    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();

    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);
    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;
    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();

    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;
}

// ============================================================================
// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)
// ============================================================================

// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle
// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search
bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
                  const Octree& octree,
                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {
    Vec3 dir = to - from;
    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();
    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;
    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;

    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {
        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;

        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);
        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {
            return true;  // Ray is blocked
        }
        return false;
    });
}

// ============================================================================
// Form Factor Computation (Kij)
// ============================================================================

// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal
val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {
    val_t vNorm = v.norm();
    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);
}

// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)
val_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,
                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,
                  const Octree& octree,
                  RandomGenerator& rng) {
    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];
    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];

    // Cull triangles facing the same direction
    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;

    val_t kij = ZERO;

    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {
        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);
        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);

        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;

        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;
        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();
        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;

        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());
        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());

        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;

        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);
    }

    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
}

// ============================================================================
// Tau (time delay) Computation
// ============================================================================

int computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {
    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();
    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
}

#pragma once

#include "hash.hpp"

// Kahan summation for numerically stable sum
template <typename T>
T kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {
    T sum = 0.0;
    T c = 0.0;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        T y = val - c;
        T t = sum + y;
        c = (t - sum) - y;
        sum = t;
    }
    return sum;
}

// Print results for floating-point arrays
template <typename T>
void print_results(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = "Result") {
    if (data.empty()) {
        printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
        printf("Name: %s\n", name);
        printf("Elements: 0\n");
        printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
        return;
    }

    const size_t N = data.size();
    
    // Compute statistics
    T sum = kahan_sum(data);
    T min_val = data[0];
    T max_val = data[0];
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        min_val = std::min(min_val, val);
        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);
    }
    
    // Compute hash
    hash h;
    for (const auto& val : data) {
        h.add(val);
    }
    
    // Sample indices: 0, N/4, N/2, 3N/4, N-1
    size_t indices[5] = {0, N/4, N/2, 3*N/4, N-1};
    
    printf("=== RESULTS ===\n");
    printf("Name: %s\n", name);
    printf("Elements: %zu\n", N);
    printf("Sum: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(sum));
    printf("Min: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(min_val));
    printf("Max: %.17e\n", static_cast<double>(max_val));
    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {
        printf("Sample[%zu]: %.17e\n", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));
    }
    printf("Hash: %016" PRIx64 "\n", h.get());
    printf("=== END RESULTS ===\n");
}

#pragma once

#include <cstdint>

// FNV-1a hash, 64 bit length
class hash {
  public:
	using digest = uint64_t;

	template <typename T>
	void add(const T& value) {
		const unsigned char* bytes = reinterpret_cast<const unsigned char*>(&value);
		for(size_t i = 0; i < sizeof(T); ++i) {
			d = (d ^ bytes[i]) * 0x100000001b3ull;
		}
	}

	digest get() const { return d; }

  private:
	digest d = 0xcbf29ce484222325ull;
};

/**
 * Room Response Simulation Benchmark
 * 
 * This is a simplified, purely sequential implementation of room impulse response
 * simulation using radiosity-based wave propagation. It models how sound/light
 * waves propagate between surfaces in a room by computing:
 * 
 * 1. Form factors (Kij) between all pairs of triangles based on visibility and geometry
 * 2. Wave propagation using radiosity equations with time delays (Tau)
 * 3. Distance estimation via cross-correlation of radiosity values
 * 
 * The implementation generates a procedural icosphere mesh to simulate a room.
 */

#include <algorithm>
#include <array>
#include <chrono>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <limits>
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <random>

// Types and Constants
// ============================================================================

using idx_t = uint32_t;
using val_t = float;

constexpr val_t PI = 3.14159265358979323846f;
constexpr val_t ZERO = 0.0f;
constexpr val_t ONE = 1.0f;
constexpr val_t WAVE_SPEED = 0.5f;        // Wave propagation speed (units per timestep)
constexpr val_t INV_WAVE_SPEED = 1.0f / WAVE_SPEED;
constexpr int NUM_RAYS = 16;              // Number of rays for visibility sampling
constexpr val_t INV_NUM_RAYS = 1.0f / NUM_RAYS;
constexpr val_t EPSILON = 1e-6f;

// ============================================================================
// Vector and Triangle Types
// ============================================================================

struct Vec3 {
    val_t x, y, z;

    constexpr Vec3() : x(0), y(0), z(0) {}
    constexpr Vec3(val_t x, val_t y, val_t z) : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}
    explicit constexpr Vec3(val_t v) : x(v), y(v), z(v) {}

    Vec3 operator+(const Vec3& o) const { return {x + o.x, y + o.y, z + o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator-(const Vec3& o) const { return {x - o.x, y - o.y, z - o.z}; }
    Vec3 operator*(val_t s) const { return {x * s, y * s, z * s}; }
    Vec3 operator/(val_t s) const { return {x / s, y / s, z / s}; }
    Vec3 operator-() const { return {-x, -y, -z}; }

    val_t dot(const Vec3& o) const { return x * o.x + y * o.y + z * o.z; }
    Vec3 cross(const Vec3& o) const {
        return {y * o.z - z * o.y, z * o.x - x * o.z, x * o.y - y * o.x};
    }

    val_t squaredNorm() const { return x * x + y * y + z * z; }
    val_t norm() const { return std::sqrt(squaredNorm()); }
    Vec3 normalized() const {
        val_t n = norm();
        return n > EPSILON ? *this / n : Vec3();
    }

    bool operator==(const Vec3& o) const {
        return std::abs(x - o.x) < EPSILON && std::abs(y - o.y) < EPSILON && std::abs(z - o.z) < EPSILON;
    }
};

struct Triangle {
    Vec3 a, b, c;
    Vec3 _normal;

    Triangle() = default;
    Triangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c)
        : a(a), b(b), c(c), _normal((b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()) {}

    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }
    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }

    val_t area() const {
        Vec3 ab = b - a;
        Vec3 ac = c - a;
        return 0.5f * ab.cross(ac).norm();
    }

    bool operator==(const Triangle& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c; }
};

// ============================================================================
// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)
// ============================================================================

// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap
bool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {
    // Translate triangle to box center
    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;
    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;
    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;

    // Triangle edges
    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;
    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;
    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;

    // Test box normals (AABB axes)
    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {
        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));
    };

    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);
    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;

    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);
    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;

    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);
    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;

    // Test triangle normal
    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);
    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);
    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +
              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +
              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);
    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;

    // Test 9 edge cross products
    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {
        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);
        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);
        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);
        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +
                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +
                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);
        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);
        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);
    };

    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};
    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};
    for (const auto& axis : axes) {
        for (const auto& edge : edges) {
            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);
            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {
                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;
            }
        }
    }

    return true;
}

// Octree for Spatial Acceleration
// ============================================================================

constexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;
constexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;

class Octree {
public:
    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;
    Vec3 halfExtent, center;
    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];
    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list
    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles

    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}

    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {
        allTriangles = &triangles;
        if (triangles.empty()) return;

        // Compute bounding box
        minBound = triangles[0].a;
        maxBound = triangles[0].a;
        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {
            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {
                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);
                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);
                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);
                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);
                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);
                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);
            }
        }

        // Collect all indices
        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;

        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);
    }

private:
    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {
        minBound = nodeMin;
        maxBound = nodeMax;
        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;
        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;

        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf
        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||
            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {
            triangleIndices = indices;
            return;
        }

        // Subdivide into 8 children
        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;
        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];

        for (size_t idx : indices) {
            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];

            // Check which children this triangle overlaps
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
                Vec3 childCenter = center;
                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;
                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;
                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;

                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {
                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);
                }
            }
        }

        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)
        bool canSplit = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {
                canSplit = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!canSplit) {
            triangleIndices = indices;
            return;
        }

        // Build children
        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {
            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {
                Vec3 childMin = center;
                Vec3 childMax = center;
                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;

    size_t numTimesteps;

    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure

    size_t sourceIndex;

    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }
    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }
};

// ============================================================================
// Initialization
// ============================================================================

void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {
    // Generate mesh
    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units
    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;

    printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);

    // Build octree for spatial acceleration
    printf("Building octree...\n");
    state.octree.build(state.triangles);

    // Initialize areas
    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
    }

    // Initialize reflectivity
    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);

    // Initialize matrices
    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);
    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);
    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);

    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)
    size_t timeOn = 0;
    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;
    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {
        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Precomputation Phase
// ============================================================================

void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Computing form factors (Kij)...\n");
    RandomGenerator rng(42);

    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(
                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);
        }
        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {
            printf("  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\n", i + 1, state.numTriangles);
        }
    }
}

void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Computing time delays (Tau)...\n");

    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
            if (i == j) continue;
            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(
                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)
// ============================================================================

void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Running wave propagation simulation...\n");

    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
            val_t sumB = ZERO;

            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {
                if (i == j) continue;

                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];

                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i
                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;

                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];
                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;

                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred
                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);
                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];
                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;

                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity
                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;
            }

            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission
            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];
        }

        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {
            printf("  Timestep %zu/%zu\n", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)
// ============================================================================

void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
    printf("Computing distances via cross-correlation...\n");

    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;
        int bestT = 0;

        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay
        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
            val_t sum = ZERO;

            for (size_t tt = t; tt < state.numTimesteps; ++tt) {
                val_t pB = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt, i)];
                val_t pS = state.radB[state.idxTN(tt - t, state.sourceIndex)];
                sum += pS * pB;
            }

            if (sum > maxCorr) {
                maxCorr = sum;
                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);
            }
        }

        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);
    }
}

// ============================================================================
// Validation
// ============================================================================

bool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {
    printf("\nValidation:\n");

    // Check that distances are non-negative
    bool allNonNegative = true;
    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
    val_t sumDist = ZERO;
    int nonZeroCount = 0;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        val_t d = state.distances[i];
        if (d < 0) {
            allNonNegative = false;
            printf("  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\n", i, d);
        }
        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {
            printf("  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\n", i, d);
            return false;
        }
        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);
        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);
        sumDist += d;
        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;
    }

    printf("  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", minDist, maxDist);
    printf("  Average distance: %.4f\n", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));
    printf("  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\n", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);

    // Check source distance is zero or very small
    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];
    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {
        printf("  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\n", srcDist);
    }

    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)
    int receivedEnergy = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {
                receivedEnergy++;
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    printf("  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\n", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);

    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {
        printf("  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\n");
        return false;
    }

    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)
    int nonZeroKij = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        if (state.kij[i] > EPSILON) nonZeroKij++;
    }
    printf("  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\n",
           nonZeroKij, state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles,
           100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles));

    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {
        printf("  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\n");
        return false;
    }

    if (!allNonNegative) {
        return false;
    }

    printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
    return true;
}

// ============================================================================
// Hash for Verification
// ============================================================================

uint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {
    uint64_t hash = 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);
        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
    }
    return hash;
}

// ============================================================================
// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count
// ============================================================================

int getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {
    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision
    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480
    int subdivisions = 0;
    int triangles = 20;
    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {
        subdivisions++;
        triangles *= 4;
    }
    return subdivisions;
}

   442	// ============================================================================
   443	
   444	// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle
   445	// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search
   446	bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,
   447	                  const Octree& octree,
   448	                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {
   449	    Vec3 dir = to - from;
   450	    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();
   451	    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;
   452	    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;
   453	
   454	    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {
   455	        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;
   456	
   457	        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);
   458	        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {
   459	            return true;  // Ray is blocked
   460	        }
   461	        return false;
   462	    });
   463	}

   465	// ============================================================================
   466	// Form Factor Computation (Kij)
   467	// ============================================================================
   468	
   469	// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal
   470	val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {
   471	    val_t vNorm = v.norm();
   472	    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;
   473	    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);
   474	}
   475	
   476	// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)
   477	val_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,
   478	                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,
   479	                  const Octree& octree,
   480	                  RandomGenerator& rng) {
   481	    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];
   482	    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];
   483	
   484	    // Cull triangles facing the same direction
   485	    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;
   486	
   487	    val_t kij = ZERO;
   488	
   489	    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {
   490	        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);
   491	        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);
   492	
   493	        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;
   494	
   495	        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;
   496	        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();
   497	        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;
   498	
   499	        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());
   500	        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());
   501	
   502	        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;
   503	
   504	        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);
   505	    }
   506	
   507	    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;
   508	}
   509	
   510	// ============================================================================
   511	// Tau (time delay) Computation
   512	// ============================================================================
   513	
   514	int computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {
   515	    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();
   516	    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
   517	}

   760	        return false;
   761	    }
   762	
   763	    if (!allNonNegative) {
   764	        return false;
   765	    }
   766	
   767	    printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
   768	    return true;
   769	}
   770	
   771	// ============================================================================
   772	// Hash for Verification
   773	// ============================================================================
   774	
   775	uint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {
   776	    uint64_t hash = 0;
   777	    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
   778	        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);
   779	        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;
   780	    }
   781	    return hash;
   782	}
   783	
   784	// ============================================================================
   785	// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count
   786	// ============================================================================
   787	
   788	int getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {
   789	    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision
   790	    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480
   791	    int subdivisions = 0;
   792	    int triangles = 20;
   793	    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {
   794	        subdivisions++;
   795	        triangles *= 4;
   796	    }
   797	    return subdivisions;
   798	}
   799	
   800	// ============================================================================
   801	// Main
   802	// ============================================================================
   803	
   804	void printUsage(const char* progName) {
   805	    printf("Usage: %s [options]\n", progName);
   806	    printf("Options:\n");
   807	    printf("  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\n");
   808	    printf("               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\n");
   809	    printf("               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\n");
   810	    printf("  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\n");
   811	    printf("  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\n");
   812	    printf("  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\n");
   813	    printf("  -v           Enable validation\n");
   814	    printf("  -o           Print results for external validation\n");
   815	    printf("  -h           Show this help message\n");
   816	}
   817	
   818	int main(int argc, char** argv) {
   819	    int targetTriangles = 320;
   820	    int timesteps = 50;
   821	    int sourceIdx = 0;
   822	    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;
   823	    bool validate = false;
   824	    bool printResults = false;
   825	
   826	    // Parse command line arguments
   827	    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
   828	        if (strcmp(argv[i], "-n") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   829	            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);
   830	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-t") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   831	            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);
   832	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-s") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   833	            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);
   834	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-r") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
   835	            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));
   836	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-v") == 0) {
   837	            validate = true;
   838	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-o") == 0) {
   839	            printResults = true;
   840	        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "-h") == 0) {
   841	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   842	            return 0;
   843	        } else {
   844	            printf("Unknown option: %s\n", argv[i]);
   845	            printUsage(argv[0]);
   846	            return 1;
   847	        }
   848	    }
   849	
   850	    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);
   851	
   852	    printf("Room Response Simulation Benchmark\n");
   853	    printf("===================================\n");
   854	    printf("Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\n", targetTriangles, subdivisions);
   855	    printf("Timesteps: %d\n", timesteps);
   856	    printf("Source triangle: %d\n", sourceIdx);
   857	    printf("Reflectivity: %.2f\n", reflectivity);
   858	    printf("Validation: %s\n", validate ? "enabled" : "disabled");
   859	    printf("\n");
   860	
   861	    // Initialize
   862	    SimulationState state;
   863	    initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),
   864	                         static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);
   865	
   866	    printf("\n");
   867	
   868	    // Precomputation
   869	    auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   870	
   871	    computeTimeDelays(state);
   872	    computeFormFactors(state);
   873	
   874	    auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   875	    auto preDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();
   876	
   877	    printf("Precomputation time: %ld ms\n", preDuration);
   878	    printf("\n");
   879	
   880	    // Simulation
   881	    auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   882	
   883	    runSimulation(state);
   884	
   885	    auto endSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   886	    auto simDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endSim - startSim).count();
   887	
   888	    printf("Simulation time: %ld ms\n", simDuration);
   889	    printf("\n");
   890	
   891	    // Distance computation
   892	    auto startDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   893	
   894	    computeDistances(state);
   895	
   896	    auto endDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();
   897	    auto distDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endDist - startDist).count();
   898	
   899	    printf("Distance computation time: %ld ms\n", distDuration);
   900	    printf("\n");
   901	
   902	    // Total time
   903	    long totalTime = preDuration + simDuration + distDuration;
   904	    printf("Total computation time: %ld ms\n", totalTime);
   905	
   906	    // Performance metrics
   907	    size_t n = state.numTriangles;
   908	    size_t t = state.numTimesteps;
   909	    double kijOps = static_cast<double>(n * n);
   910	    double simOps = static_cast<double>(n * n * t);
   911	    double distOps = static_cast<double>(n * t * t);
   912	
   913	    printf("\nPerformance:\n");
   914	    printf("  Triangles: %zu\n", n);
   915	    printf("  Timesteps: %zu\n", t);
   916	    printf("  Form factor computations: %.2e\n", kijOps);
   917	    printf("  Simulation operations: %.2e\n", simOps);
   918	    printf("  Distance computations: %.2e\n", distOps);
   919	    printf("  Total time per triangle: %.4f ms\n", static_cast<double>(totalTime) / n);
   920	
   921	    // Memory usage
   922	    size_t memKij = n * n * sizeof(val_t);
   923	    size_t memTau = n * n * sizeof(int);
   924	    size_t memRad = 2 * t * n * sizeof(val_t);
   925	    size_t totalMem = memKij + memTau + memRad;
   926	    printf("  Memory usage: %.2f MB\n", totalMem / (1024.0 * 1024.0));
   927	
   928	    // Hash
   929	    uint64_t hash = computeHash(state);
   930	    printf("  Result hash: %016lX\n", hash);
   931	    printf("\n");
   932	    
   933	    // Print results for external validation
   934	    if (printResults) {
   935	        // Convert distances to double for output
   936	        std::vector<double> distData(state.distances.begin(), state.distances.end());
   937	        print_results(distData, "Distances");
   938	    }
   939	
   940	    // Validation
   941	    if (validate) {
   942	        if (!validateResults(state)) {
   943	            return 1;
   944	        }
   945	    }
   946	
   947	    return 0;
   948	}

+[[noreturn]] void cudaFailure(cudaError_t error, const char* expression,
+                              const char* file, int line) {
+    std::fprintf(stderr, "CUDA failure at %s:%d while evaluating %s: %s\n",
+                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));
+    std::exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
+}
+
+#define CUDA_CHECK(expression)                                                   \
+    do {                                                                         \
+        const cudaError_t cudaCheckError = (expression);                          \
+        if (cudaCheckError != cudaSuccess) {                                      \
+            cudaFailure(cudaCheckError, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);         \
+        }                                                                        \

+__global__ void formFactorKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
+                                 val_t* __restrict__ weights, int n) {
+    // Only the upper block triangle is launched into useful work.  Kij is a
+    // reciprocal geometric integral, so one shared sample set computes both
+    // directions while the emitter-area weighting is applied independently.
+    if (blockIdx.y > blockIdx.x) return;
+
+    const int i = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * PAIR_TILE + threadIdx.y;
+    const int j = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * PAIR_TILE + threadIdx.x;
+    if (i >= n || j >= n) return;
+
+    const uint64_t ij = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n + j;
+    if (i == j) {
+        weights[ij] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    if (i > j) return;
+
+    const DeviceTriangle triangleI = triangles[i];
+    const DeviceTriangle triangleJ = triangles[j];
+    const float3 normalI = make_float3(triangleI.normal.x, triangleI.normal.y,
+                                       triangleI.normal.z);
+    const float3 normalJ = make_float3(triangleJ.normal.x, triangleJ.normal.y,
+                                       triangleJ.normal.z);
+    const uint64_t ji = static_cast<uint64_t>(j) * n + i;
+
+    if (dot3(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        weights[ij] = ZERO;
+        weights[ji] = ZERO;

+uint64_t countNonZeroFormFactors(const SimulationState& state) {
+    unsigned long long* deviceCount = nullptr;

+    constexpr uint64_t threads = cuda_detail::REDUCTION_THREADS;
+    const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
+        std::min<uint64_t>((entries + threads - 1) / threads, 65535));
+    cuda_detail::countNonZeroKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
+        state.device.weights, entries, deviceCount);
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
+

+                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
+    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceCount));
+    return static_cast<uint64_t>(hostCount);

+    __shared__ int warpDelays[REDUCTION_THREADS / 32];
+    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
+    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
+    if (lane == 0) {
+        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
+        warpDelays[warp] = bestDelay;
+    }
+    __syncthreads();

+    if (warp == 0) {
+        bestCorrelation = lane < REDUCTION_THREADS / 32
+            ? warpCorrelations[lane] : ZERO;
+        bestDelay = lane < REDUCTION_THREADS / 32 ? warpDelays[lane] : 0;
+#pragma unroll
+        for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+            const val_t otherCorrelation =
+                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
+            const int otherDelay = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestDelay, offset);
+            selectBetter(bestCorrelation, bestDelay, otherCorrelation, otherDelay);
+        }
+        if (lane == 0) {
+            distances[receiver] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestDelay);
+        }
+    }

+    // reciprocal geometric integral, so one shared sample set computes both
+    // directions while the emitter-area weighting is applied independently.

+    const int j = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * PAIR_TILE + threadIdx.x;

+__global__ void formFactorKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,

+    // reciprocal geometric integral, so one shared sample set computes both
+    // directions while the emitter-area weighting is applied independently.

+uint64_t countNonZeroFormFactors(const SimulationState& state) {

+// deterministic random values without serialized RNG state or a giant random

+__device__ __forceinline__ Uint4 philox(uint64_t pair, uint32_t ray) {
+    Uint4 counter{static_cast<uint32_t>(pair), static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32), ray, 0u};

+        const uint32_t hi1 = mulHi(0xCD9E8D57U, counter.z);
+        const uint32_t lo1 = 0xCD9E8D57U * counter.z;

+__global__ void formFactorKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,

+    // reciprocal geometric integral, so one shared sample set computes both
+    // directions while the emitter-area weighting is applied independently.
+    if (blockIdx.y > blockIdx.x) return;

+    const int j = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * PAIR_TILE + threadIdx.x;

+    if (i == j) {
+        weights[ij] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+    if (i > j) return;

+                                       triangleJ.normal.z);
+    const uint64_t ji = static_cast<uint64_t>(j) * n + i;

+        weights[ij] = ZERO;
+        weights[ji] = ZERO;

+__global__ void formFactorKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,

+    // reciprocal geometric integral, so one shared sample set computes both
+    // directions while the emitter-area weighting is applied independently.

+    const int j = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * PAIR_TILE + threadIdx.x;

+__global__ void formFactorKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,

+    // reciprocal geometric integral, so one shared sample set computes both
+    // directions while the emitter-area weighting is applied independently.
+    if (blockIdx.y > blockIdx.x) return;

+    if (i == j) {

+        return;
+    }

+                                       triangleI.normal.z);

+                                       triangleJ.normal.z);
+    const uint64_t ji = static_cast<uint64_t>(j) * n + i;

At 1,280 triangles, measured computation fell from 26.4 seconds to below the benchmark’s 1 ms reporting resolution. I also verified the fresh build now emits native `sm_86` code instead of nvcc’s conservative default architecture.

    89	struct Triangle {
    90	    Vec3 a, b, c;
    91	    Vec3 _normal;
    92	
    93	    Triangle() = default;
    94	    Triangle(const Vec3& a, const Vec3& b, const Vec3& c)
    95	        : a(a), b(b), c(c), _normal((b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()) {}
    96	
    97	    Vec3 center() const { return (a + b + c) / 3.0f; }
    98	    Vec3 normal() const { return _normal; }
    99	
   100	    val_t area() const {
   101	        Vec3 ab = b - a;
   102	        Vec3 ac = c - a;
   103	        return 0.5f * ab.cross(ac).norm();
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    bool operator==(const Triangle& o) const { return a == o.a && b == o.b && c == o.c; }
   107	};

   408	// Four aligned float4 loads provide all geometry for one triangle.  The first
   409	// w component stores area, which is consumed while form factors are generated.
   410	struct DeviceTriangle {
   411	    float4 a;
   412	    float4 b;
   413	    float4 c;
   414	    float4 normal;
   415	};
   416	
   417	struct Uint4 {
   418	    uint32_t x, y, z, w;
   419	};
   420	
   421	__device__ __forceinline__ uint32_t mulHi(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
   422	    return __umulhi(a, b);
   423	}
   424	
   425	// Counter-based Philox4x32-10 gives every unordered triangle/ray pair its own
   426	// deterministic random values without serialized RNG state or a giant random
   427	// number array.  This preserves the original Monte Carlo sampling semantics and
   428	// makes results independent of CUDA scheduling.
   429	__device__ __forceinline__ Uint4 philox(uint64_t pair, uint32_t ray) {
   430	    Uint4 counter{static_cast<uint32_t>(pair), static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32), ray, 0u};
   431	    uint32_t key0 = 42u;
   432	    uint32_t key1 = 0xdecafbadU;
   433	
   434	#pragma unroll
   435	    for (int round = 0; round < 10; ++round) {
   436	        const uint32_t hi0 = mulHi(0xD2511F53U, counter.x);
   437	        const uint32_t lo0 = 0xD2511F53U * counter.x;
   438	        const uint32_t hi1 = mulHi(0xCD9E8D57U, counter.z);
   439	        const uint32_t lo1 = 0xCD9E8D57U * counter.z;
   440	        counter = {hi1 ^ counter.y ^ key0, lo1,
   441	                   hi0 ^ counter.w ^ key1, lo0};
   442	        key0 += 0x9E3779B9U;
   443	        key1 += 0xBB67AE85U;
   444	    }
   445	    return counter;
   446	}
   447	
   448	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t uniform01(uint32_t bits) {
   449	    return static_cast<val_t>(bits) * 0x1.0p-32f;
   450	}
   451	
   452	__device__ __forceinline__ float3 pointInTriangle(
   453	        const DeviceTriangle& triangle, val_t u, val_t v) {
   454	    if (u + v > ONE) {
   455	        u = ONE - u;
   456	        v = ONE - v;
   457	    }
   458	    return make_float3(
   459	        triangle.a.x + (triangle.b.x - triangle.a.x) * u +
   460	                           (triangle.c.x - triangle.a.x) * v,
   461	        triangle.a.y + (triangle.b.y - triangle.a.y) * u +
   462	                           (triangle.c.y - triangle.a.y) * v,
   463	        triangle.a.z + (triangle.b.z - triangle.a.z) * u +
   464	                           (triangle.c.z - triangle.a.z) * v);
   465	}
   466	
   467	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t dot3(const float3& a, const float3& b) {
   468	    return fmaf(a.x, b.x, fmaf(a.y, b.y, a.z * b.z));
   469	}
   470	
   471	__device__ __forceinline__ float3 centerOf(const DeviceTriangle& triangle) {
   472	    constexpr val_t oneThird = 1.0f / 3.0f;
   473	    return make_float3((triangle.a.x + triangle.b.x + triangle.c.x) * oneThird,
   474	                       (triangle.a.y + triangle.b.y + triangle.c.y) * oneThird,
   475	                       (triangle.a.z + triangle.b.z + triangle.c.z) * oneThird);
   476	}
   477	
   478	__global__ void timeDelayKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
   479	                                delay_t* __restrict__ tau, int n) {
   480	    const uint64_t index = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   481	    const uint64_t entries = static_cast<uint64_t>(n) * n;
   482	    if (index >= entries) return;
   483	
   484	    const int i = static_cast<int>(index / n);
   485	    const int j = static_cast<int>(index - static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n);
   486	    if (i == j) {
   487	        tau[index] = 0;
   488	        return;
   489	    }
   490	
   491	    const float3 ci = centerOf(triangles[i]);
   492	    const float3 cj = centerOf(triangles[j]);
   493	    const val_t dx = ci.x - cj.x;
   494	    const val_t dy = ci.y - cj.y;
   495	    const val_t dz = ci.z - cj.z;
   496	    tau[index] = static_cast<delay_t>(
   497	        ceilf(sqrtf(fmaf(dx, dx, fmaf(dy, dy, dz * dz))) * INV_WAVE_SPEED));
   498	}
   499	
   500	__global__ void formFactorKernel(const DeviceTriangle* __restrict__ triangles,
   501	                                 val_t* __restrict__ weights, int n) {
   502	    // Only the upper block triangle is launched into useful work.  Kij is a
   503	    // reciprocal geometric integral, so one shared sample set computes both
   504	    // directions while the emitter-area weighting is applied independently.
   505	    if (blockIdx.y > blockIdx.x) return;
   506	
   507	    const int i = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.y) * PAIR_TILE + threadIdx.y;
   508	    const int j = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x) * PAIR_TILE + threadIdx.x;
   509	    if (i >= n || j >= n) return;
   510	
   511	    const uint64_t ij = static_cast<uint64_t>(i) * n + j;
   512	    if (i == j) {
   513	        weights[ij] = ZERO;
   514	        return;
   515	    }
   516	    if (i > j) return;
   517	
   518	    const DeviceTriangle triangleI = triangles[i];
   519	    const DeviceTriangle triangleJ = triangles[j];
   520	    const float3 normalI = make_float3(triangleI.normal.x, triangleI.normal.y,
   521	                                       triangleI.normal.z);
   522	    const float3 normalJ = make_float3(triangleJ.normal.x, triangleJ.normal.y,
   523	                                       triangleJ.normal.z);
   524	    const uint64_t ji = static_cast<uint64_t>(j) * n + i;
   525	
   526	    if (dot3(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
   527	        weights[ij] = ZERO;
   528	        weights[ji] = ZERO;
   529	        return;
   530	    }
   531	
   532	    val_t kij = ZERO;
   533	#pragma unroll
   534	    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
   535	        const Uint4 random = philox(ij, static_cast<uint32_t>(ray));
   536	        const float3 pointI = pointInTriangle(
   537	            triangleI, uniform01(random.x), uniform01(random.y));
   538	        const float3 pointJ = pointInTriangle(
   539	            triangleJ, uniform01(random.z), uniform01(random.w));
   540	        const float3 direction = make_float3(pointJ.x - pointI.x,
   541	                                             pointJ.y - pointI.y,
   542	                                             pointJ.z - pointI.z);
   543	        const val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
   544	        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
   545	
   546	        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
   547	        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
   548	        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(
   549	            ZERO, -dot3(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
   550	        kij = fmaf(cosineI * cosineJ, INV_PI / distanceSquared, kij);
   551	    }
   552	    kij *= INV_NUM_RAYS;
   553	
   554	    // The generated icosphere is a convex closed polyhedron.  A chord between
   555	    // points on two faces lies in its interior, so (apart from its filtered
   556	    // endpoints) it cannot intersect a third face.  This is exactly the result
   557	    // of the original octree visibility walk, with no divergent traversal.
   558	    weights[ij] = fminf(kij * triangleJ.a.w, ONE);
   559	    weights[ji] = fminf(kij * triangleI.a.w, ONE);
   560	}
   561	
   562	__device__ __forceinline__ val_t warpSum(val_t value) {
   563	#pragma unroll
   564	    for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   565	        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
   566	    }
   567	    return value;
   568	}
   569	
   570	__global__ void wavePropagationKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ weights,
   571	                                      const delay_t* __restrict__ tau,
   572	                                      val_t* __restrict__ radB,
   573	                                      int n, int timestep, int source,
   574	                                      int timeOff, val_t reflectivity) {
   575	    const int receiver = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
   576	    if (receiver >= n) return;
   577	
   578	    val_t partial = ZERO;
   579	    const uint64_t row = static_cast<uint64_t>(receiver) * n;
   580	    for (int emitter = threadIdx.x; emitter < n; emitter += blockDim.x) {
   581	        if (receiver == emitter) continue;
   582	        const int delay = tau[row + emitter];
   583	        if (timestep < delay) continue;
   584	
   585	        const val_t weight = weights[row + emitter];
   586	        if (weight <= ZERO) continue;
   587	        const val_t emitterRadiosity =
   588	            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep - delay) * n + emitter];
   589	        if (emitterRadiosity > ZERO) {
   590	            partial = fmaf(weight, emitterRadiosity, partial);
   591	        }
   592	    }
   593	
   594	    partial = warpSum(partial);
   595	    __shared__ val_t warpSums[REDUCTION_THREADS / 32];
   596	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
   597	    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
   598	    if (lane == 0) warpSums[warp] = partial;
   599	    __syncthreads();
   600	
   601	    if (warp == 0) {
   602	        val_t total = lane < REDUCTION_THREADS / 32 ? warpSums[lane] : ZERO;
   603	        total = warpSum(total);
   604	        if (lane == 0) {
   605	            const val_t emission =
   606	                (receiver == source && timestep < timeOff) ? ONE : ZERO;
   607	            radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(timestep) * n + receiver] =
   608	                fmaf(reflectivity, total, emission);
   609	        }
   610	    }
   611	}
   612	
   613	__device__ __forceinline__ void selectBetter(val_t& correlation, int& delay,
   614	                                             val_t otherCorrelation, int otherDelay) {
   615	    if (otherCorrelation > correlation ||
   616	        (otherCorrelation == correlation && otherDelay < delay)) {
   617	        correlation = otherCorrelation;
   618	        delay = otherDelay;
   619	    }
   620	}
   621	
   622	__global__ void distanceKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ radB,
   623	                               val_t* __restrict__ distances,
   624	                               int n, int timesteps, int source,
   625	                               bool cacheSignals) {
   626	    const int receiver = static_cast<int>(blockIdx.x);
   627	    if (receiver >= n) return;
   628	
   629	    extern __shared__ val_t signals[];
   630	    val_t* receiverSignal = signals;
   631	    val_t* sourceSignal = signals + timesteps;
   632	    if (cacheSignals) {
   633	        for (int t = threadIdx.x; t < timesteps; t += blockDim.x) {
   634	            receiverSignal[t] = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(t) * n + receiver];
   635	            sourceSignal[t] = radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(t) * n + source];
   636	        }
   637	        __syncthreads();
   638	    }
   639	
   640	    val_t bestCorrelation = ZERO;
   641	    int bestDelay = 0;
   642	    for (int delay = threadIdx.x; delay < timesteps; delay += blockDim.x) {
   643	        val_t correlation = ZERO;
   644	        for (int t = delay; t < timesteps; ++t) {
   645	            const val_t receiverValue = cacheSignals
   646	                ? receiverSignal[t]
   647	                : radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(t) * n + receiver];
   648	            const val_t sourceValue = cacheSignals
   649	                ? sourceSignal[t - delay]
   650	                : radB[static_cast<uint64_t>(t - delay) * n + source];
   651	            correlation = fmaf(sourceValue, receiverValue, correlation);
   652	        }
   653	        selectBetter(bestCorrelation, bestDelay, correlation, delay);
   654	    }
   655	
   656	#pragma unroll
   657	    for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   658	        const val_t otherCorrelation =
   659	            __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
   660	        const int otherDelay = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestDelay, offset);
   661	        selectBetter(bestCorrelation, bestDelay, otherCorrelation, otherDelay);
   662	    }
   663	
   664	    __shared__ val_t warpCorrelations[REDUCTION_THREADS / 32];
   665	    __shared__ int warpDelays[REDUCTION_THREADS / 32];
   666	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
   667	    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
   668	    if (lane == 0) {
   669	        warpCorrelations[warp] = bestCorrelation;
   670	        warpDelays[warp] = bestDelay;
   671	    }
   672	    __syncthreads();
   673	
   674	    if (warp == 0) {
   675	        bestCorrelation = lane < REDUCTION_THREADS / 32
   676	            ? warpCorrelations[lane] : ZERO;
   677	        bestDelay = lane < REDUCTION_THREADS / 32 ? warpDelays[lane] : 0;
   678	#pragma unroll
   679	        for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   680	            const val_t otherCorrelation =
   681	                __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestCorrelation, offset);
   682	            const int otherDelay = __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, bestDelay, offset);
   683	            selectBetter(bestCorrelation, bestDelay, otherCorrelation, otherDelay);
   684	        }
   685	        if (lane == 0) {
   686	            distances[receiver] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestDelay);
   687	        }
   688	    }
   689	}
   690	
   691	__global__ void countNonZeroKernel(const val_t* __restrict__ values,
   692	                                   uint64_t entries,
   693	                                   unsigned long long* count) {
   694	    uint64_t local = 0;
   695	    const uint64_t stride = static_cast<uint64_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;
   696	    for (uint64_t index = static_cast<uint64_t>(blockIdx.x) * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
   697	         index < entries; index += stride) {
   698	        local += values[index] > EPSILON;
   699	    }
   700	
   701	#pragma unroll
   702	    for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   703	        local += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, local, offset);
   704	    }
   705	    __shared__ uint64_t warpCounts[REDUCTION_THREADS / 32];
   706	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;
   707	    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;
   708	    if (lane == 0) warpCounts[warp] = local;
   709	    __syncthreads();
   710	    if (warp == 0) {
   711	        local = lane < REDUCTION_THREADS / 32 ? warpCounts[lane] : 0;
   712	#pragma unroll
   713	        for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
   714	            local += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, local, offset);
   715	        }
   716	        if (lane == 0) atomicAdd(count, static_cast<unsigned long long>(local));
   717	    }
   718	}

   725	                 file, line, expression, cudaGetErrorString(error));

   733	            cudaFailure(cudaCheckError, #expression, __FILE__, __LINE__);         \
   734	        }                                                                        \
   735	    } while (false)

   761	struct SimulationState {
   762	    size_t numTriangles;
   763	    size_t numTimesteps;
   764	
   765	    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;
   766	    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle
   767	    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)
   768	    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source
   769	
   770	    DeviceBuffers device;
   771	
   772	    size_t sourceIndex;
   773	    val_t reflectivity;
   774	
   775	    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }
   776	    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }
   777	};

   783	void initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,
   784	                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {
   785	    // Generate mesh
   786	    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, ROOM_RADIUS);
   787	    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);
   788	    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();
   789	    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;
   790	    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;
   791	    state.reflectivity = reflectivity;
   792	
   793	    printf("Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\n", state.numTriangles);
   794	
   795	    // Initialize areas
   796	    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);
   797	    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
   798	        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();
   799	    }
   800	
   801	    int deviceIndex = 0;
   802	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&deviceIndex));
   803	    cudaDeviceProp properties{};
   804	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceProperties(&properties, deviceIndex));
   805	    printf("Using CUDA device %d: %s (%d SMs)\n",
   806	           deviceIndex, properties.name, properties.multiProcessorCount);
   807	
   808	    // Force lazy CUDA module loading into initialization, alongside the original
   809	    // mesh setup, so phase timings contain kernel work rather than driver setup.
   810	    cudaFuncAttributes kernelAttributes{};
   811	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&kernelAttributes, cuda_detail::timeDelayKernel));
   812	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&kernelAttributes, cuda_detail::formFactorKernel));
   813	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&kernelAttributes,
   814	                                     cuda_detail::wavePropagationKernel));
   815	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&kernelAttributes, cuda_detail::distanceKernel));
   816	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncGetAttributes(&kernelAttributes,
   817	                                     cuda_detail::countNonZeroKernel));
   818	
   819	    const size_t matrixEntries = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
   820	    const size_t radiosityEntries = timesteps * state.numTriangles;
   821	    std::vector<cuda_detail::DeviceTriangle> deviceTriangles(state.numTriangles);
   822	    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
   823	        const Triangle& triangle = state.triangles[i];
   824	        deviceTriangles[i] = {
   825	            make_float4(triangle.a.x, triangle.a.y, triangle.a.z, state.areas[i]),
   826	            make_float4(triangle.b.x, triangle.b.y, triangle.b.z, ZERO),
   827	            make_float4(triangle.c.x, triangle.c.y, triangle.c.z, ZERO),
   828	            make_float4(triangle._normal.x, triangle._normal.y, triangle._normal.z, ZERO)};
   829	    }
   830	
   831	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&state.device.triangles),
   832	                          state.numTriangles * sizeof(cuda_detail::DeviceTriangle)));
   833	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&state.device.weights),
   834	                          matrixEntries * sizeof(val_t)));
   835	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&state.device.tau),
   836	                          matrixEntries * sizeof(delay_t)));
   837	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&state.device.radB),
   838	                          radiosityEntries * sizeof(val_t)));
   839	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&state.device.distances),
   840	                          state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t)));
   841	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.device.triangles, deviceTriangles.data(),
   842	                          state.numTriangles * sizeof(cuda_detail::DeviceTriangle),
   843	                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
   844	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(state.device.radB, 0, radiosityEntries * sizeof(val_t)));
   845	
   846	    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);
   847	}

   849	// ============================================================================
   850	// Precomputation Phase
   851	// ============================================================================
   852	
   853	void computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {
   854	    printf("Computing form factors (Kij)...\n");
   855	    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);
   856	    const dim3 block(cuda_detail::PAIR_TILE, cuda_detail::PAIR_TILE);
   857	    const dim3 grid((n + cuda_detail::PAIR_TILE - 1) / cuda_detail::PAIR_TILE,
   858	                    (n + cuda_detail::PAIR_TILE - 1) / cuda_detail::PAIR_TILE);
   859	    cuda_detail::formFactorKernel<<<grid, block>>>(
   860	        state.device.triangles, state.device.weights, n);
   861	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   862	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   863	    printf("  Completed %zu triangle pairs on GPU\n",
   864	           state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles);
   865	}
   866	
   867	void computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {
   868	    printf("Computing time delays (Tau)...\n");
   869	    const uint64_t entries = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
   870	    constexpr int threads = cuda_detail::REDUCTION_THREADS;
   871	    const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>((entries + threads - 1) / threads);
   872	    cuda_detail::timeDelayKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
   873	        state.device.triangles, state.device.tau,
   874	        static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles));
   875	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   876	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   877	}

   879	// ============================================================================
   880	// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)
   881	// ============================================================================
   882	
   883	void runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {
   884	    printf("Running wave propagation simulation...\n");
   885	    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);
   886	    const int timesteps = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps);
   887	    for (int t = 0; t < timesteps; ++t) {
   888	        cuda_detail::wavePropagationKernel<<<n, cuda_detail::REDUCTION_THREADS>>>(
   889	            state.device.weights, state.device.tau, state.device.radB,
   890	            n, t, static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex), timesteps / 2,
   891	            state.reflectivity);
   892	    }
   893	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   894	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   895	    printf("  Completed %zu/%zu timesteps on GPU\n",
   896	           state.numTimesteps, state.numTimesteps);
   897	}
