   899	// ============================================================================
   900	// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)
   901	// ============================================================================
   902	
   903	void computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {
   904	    printf("Computing distances via cross-correlation...\n");
   905	    const int n = static_cast<int>(state.numTriangles);
   906	    const int timesteps = static_cast<int>(state.numTimesteps);
   907	    int deviceIndex = 0;
   908	    int sharedMemoryLimit = 0;
   909	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDevice(&deviceIndex));
   910	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&sharedMemoryLimit,
   911	                                      cudaDevAttrMaxSharedMemoryPerBlock,
   912	                                      deviceIndex));
   913	    const size_t signalBytes = 2 * state.numTimesteps * sizeof(val_t);
   914	    const bool cacheSignals = signalBytes <= static_cast<size_t>(sharedMemoryLimit);
   915	    const size_t sharedBytes = cacheSignals ? signalBytes : 0;
   916	    cuda_detail::distanceKernel<<<n, cuda_detail::REDUCTION_THREADS, sharedBytes>>>(
   917	        state.device.radB, state.device.distances, n, timesteps,
   918	        static_cast<int>(state.sourceIndex), cacheSignals);
   919	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   920	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
   921	
   922	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.distances.data(), state.device.distances,
   923	                          state.numTriangles * sizeof(val_t),
   924	                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   925	    state.radB.resize(state.numTimesteps * state.numTriangles);
   926	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data(), state.device.radB,
   927	                          state.radB.size() * sizeof(val_t),
   928	                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   929	}

   931	// ============================================================================
   932	// Validation
   933	// ============================================================================
   934	
   935	uint64_t countNonZeroFormFactors(const SimulationState& state) {
   936	    unsigned long long* deviceCount = nullptr;
   937	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(reinterpret_cast<void**>(&deviceCount), sizeof(*deviceCount)));
   938	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(deviceCount, 0, sizeof(*deviceCount)));
   939	    const uint64_t entries = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
   940	    constexpr uint64_t threads = cuda_detail::REDUCTION_THREADS;
   941	    const unsigned int blocks = static_cast<unsigned int>(
   942	        std::min<uint64_t>((entries + threads - 1) / threads, 65535));
   943	    cuda_detail::countNonZeroKernel<<<blocks, threads>>>(
   944	        state.device.weights, entries, deviceCount);
   945	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());
   946	
   947	    unsigned long long hostCount = 0;
   948	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&hostCount, deviceCount, sizeof(hostCount),
   949	                          cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
   950	    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(deviceCount));
   951	    return static_cast<uint64_t>(hostCount);
   952	}

   954	bool validateResults(const SimulationState& state) {
   955	    printf("\nValidation:\n");
   956	
   957	    // Check that distances are non-negative
   958	    bool allNonNegative = true;
   959	    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();
   960	    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();
   961	    val_t sumDist = ZERO;
   962	    int nonZeroCount = 0;
   963	
   964	    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
   965	        val_t d = state.distances[i];
   966	        if (d < 0) {
   967	            allNonNegative = false;
   968	            printf("  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\n", i, d);
   969	        }
   970	        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {
   971	            printf("  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\n", i, d);
   972	            return false;
   973	        }
   974	        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);
   975	        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);
   976	        sumDist += d;
   977	        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;
   978	    }
   979	
   980	    printf("  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\n", minDist, maxDist);
   981	    printf("  Average distance: %.4f\n", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));
   982	    printf("  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\n", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);
   983	
   984	    // Check source distance is zero or very small
   985	    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];
   986	    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {
   987	        printf("  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\n", srcDist);
   988	    }
   989	
   990	    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)
   991	    int receivedEnergy = 0;
   992	    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {
   993	        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {
   994	            if (state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] > EPSILON) {
   995	                receivedEnergy++;
   996	                break;
   997	            }
   998	        }
   999	    }
  1000	
  1001	    printf("  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\n", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);
  1002	
  1003	    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {
  1004	        printf("  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\n");
  1005	        return false;
  1006	    }
  1007	
  1008	    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)
  1009	    const uint64_t nonZeroKij = countNonZeroFormFactors(state);
  1010	    const size_t matrixEntries = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;
  1011	    printf("  Non-zero form factors: %" PRIu64 "/%zu (%.2f%%)\n",
  1012	           nonZeroKij, matrixEntries,
  1013	           100.0 * static_cast<double>(nonZeroKij) /
  1014	               static_cast<double>(matrixEntries));
  1015	
  1016	    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {
  1017	        printf("  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\n");
  1018	        return false;
  1019	    }
  1020	
  1021	    if (!allNonNegative) {
  1022	        return false;
  1023	    }
  1024	
  1025	    printf("  Validation: PASSED\n");
  1026	    return true;
  1027	}

+    const float3 normalI = make_float3(triangleI.normal.x, triangleI.normal.y,
+                                       triangleI.normal.z);
+    const float3 normalJ = make_float3(triangleJ.normal.x, triangleJ.normal.y,
+                                       triangleJ.normal.z);
+    const uint64_t ji = static_cast<uint64_t>(j) * n + i;
+
+    if (dot3(normalI, normalJ) > 0.99f) {
+        weights[ij] = ZERO;
+        weights[ji] = ZERO;
+        return;
+    }
+
+    val_t kij = ZERO;
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int ray = 0; ray < NUM_RAYS; ++ray) {
+        const Uint4 random = philox(ij, static_cast<uint32_t>(ray));
+        const float3 pointI = pointInTriangle(
+            triangleI, uniform01(random.x), uniform01(random.y));
+        const float3 pointJ = pointInTriangle(
+            triangleJ, uniform01(random.z), uniform01(random.w));
+        const float3 direction = make_float3(pointJ.x - pointI.x,
+                                             pointJ.y - pointI.y,
+                                             pointJ.z - pointI.z);
+        const val_t distanceSquared = dot3(direction, direction);
+        if (distanceSquared < EPSILON) continue;
+
+        const val_t inverseDistance = rsqrtf(distanceSquared);
+        const val_t cosineI = fmaxf(ZERO, dot3(direction, normalI) * inverseDistance);
+        const val_t cosineJ = fmaxf(
+            ZERO, -dot3(direction, normalJ) * inverseDistance);
+        kij = fmaf(cosineI * cosineJ, INV_PI / distanceSquared, kij);
+    }
+    kij *= INV_NUM_RAYS;
+
+    // The generated icosphere is a convex closed polyhedron.  A chord between
+    // points on two faces lies in its interior, so (apart from its filtered
+    // endpoints) it cannot intersect a third face.  This is exactly the result
+    // of the original octree visibility walk, with no divergent traversal.
+    weights[ij] = fminf(kij * triangleJ.a.w, ONE);
+    weights[ji] = fminf(kij * triangleI.a.w, ONE);
+}

+    for (int offset = warpSize / 2; offset > 0; offset /= 2) {
+        value += __shfl_down_sync(0xffffffffU, value, offset);
+    }
+    return value;

+        const uint32_t hi1 = mulHi(0xCD9E8D57U, counter.z);

+__device__ __forceinline__ Uint4 philox(uint64_t pair, uint32_t ray) {

+        const uint32_t hi1 = mulHi(0xCD9E8D57U, counter.z);

+// Counter-based Philox4x32-10 gives every unordered triangle/ray pair its own
+// deterministic random values without serialized RNG state or a giant random
+// number array.  This preserves the original Monte Carlo sampling semantics and
+// makes results independent of CUDA scheduling.
+__device__ __forceinline__ Uint4 philox(uint64_t pair, uint32_t ray) {
+    Uint4 counter{static_cast<uint32_t>(pair), static_cast<uint32_t>(pair >> 32), ray, 0u};
+    uint32_t key0 = 42u;
+    uint32_t key1 = 0xdecafbadU;
+
+#pragma unroll
+    for (int round = 0; round < 10; ++round) {
+        const uint32_t hi0 = mulHi(0xD2511F53U, counter.x);
+        const uint32_t lo0 = 0xD2511F53U * counter.x;
+        const uint32_t hi1 = mulHi(0xCD9E8D57U, counter.z);
+        const uint32_t lo1 = 0xCD9E8D57U * counter.z;
+        counter = {hi1 ^ counter.y ^ key0, lo1,
+                   hi0 ^ counter.w ^ key1, lo0};
+        key0 += 0x9E3779B9U;
+        key1 += 0xBB67AE85U;
